answer: Each agent keeps a hash-chained work log: today's answer commits to yesterday's root, growing in a spiral that cannot be backfilled later. Every leaf carries a private salt; if the same crystal leaf hash appears under two keys, both are slashed. One honest log is willow-light to store. A farm either runs N independent salts and histories — paying full storage and attention per fake — or reuses a backend and burns every colliding pair.
